q2_gaps: a counted plural in OBJECT / undergoer position ("killed ... two indirectly") — the per-member distribution rule of *Cardinality* / *Quantifiers* is defined for a "distributive predicate (each member acts separately)" and every example is a subject-side actor (bark, pass, arrive), so whether a group filling Patient also takes the (PartOf $x <group>) rule is unspecified
an explicit singular numeral ("one person") — Cardinality atoms ride on a group, and no rule says whether the numeral "one" on a singular witness should be recorded at all
notes: The inanimate transitive subject correctly stays Agent, kill correctly takes Patient, the gapped second conjunct is reconstructed as an independent event per the coordination rule, and both -ly adverbs keep their surface form in Manner.
